headline: An Airbnb host in Australia reportedly tried to charge a guest $1,700 for a flooded toilet, using a picture that appears to be AI-made.
score_reason: Pool score 2 kept: light story from one Reddit post, no sign the headline overstates it.
importance_line: Guests and renters are the first to be hit when AI makes fake damage photos cheap to produce, then platforms like Airbnb that must judge such claims, but this rests on one unconfirmed Reddit post.
summary: PC Gamer reports that a Reddit user says an Australian Airbnb host tried to bill them $1,700 for an overflowed toilet using a photo that looks AI-generated, and that Google's Gemini chatbot found its own hidden watermark (SynthID) in the picture. The poster says the claim was rejected, but that is the poster's own account and has not been independently confirmed.
notes: Read from the pre-fetched PC Gamer page. Date of the Reddit post is not stated; treated as new.
